criteria.evidence: Turn 0: "No — we don't support inbound read receipts yet... stream.ts never maps that case" (MessageRead oneof case 12 not wired).
Turn 1/2: "No Linear tool is available in this environment" and provided Title + Description draft ready to paste.
Turn 3 and revised turn 4 plan include consumer code: `if (msg.content.type === "read") { ... msg.content.target.id ... msg.sender.id }`.
Plan covers no breaking change, reuse of reaction precedent/resume machinery, tests (self-echo, missing actor, cache/fetch, failure) and docs updates.
Consumer samples in turn 4/5 use only `msg.content.type === "read"`; no `direction` check anywhere.

stream.ts `message.read` branch -> toReadMessages builds inbound record with `content: readSchema.parse({target, type:"read"})`, test asserts `message.content.target.id === "msg-guid"`; emulated user confirmed "working now" on live run. (No core wrapNestedContent arm added, so target is a raw record rather than a built Message, but it identifies the agent's message.)

New read-receipts.ts, stream.ts branch, readSchema export, read.ts docblock, tests all done; docs table split reported as not needed with reason ("already say read receipts generically... no doc changes were needed").

Every drop path logs a warn with reason (group chat, unparsable DM guid, target resolution failure incl. error); successful resolution logs debug. Absence of any log implies upstream never delivered the event (arrival-level log was removed in turn 9, which weakens but does not break the distinction).
Test "does not drop the event when actor equals our own line" passes; isEventFromCurrentAccount guard removed for message.read.
Test asserts `sender` is `{id: "+15557654321", address: "+15557654321"}` derived from DM guid, not the line's +15551234567.
Turn 9: "Yes, keep them"; logs use `createLogger("spectrum.imessage.read-receipts")` at warn/debug levels.

Turn 10 said URL unreachable; turn 11 assessed the described concern against code: read path no longer uses actor-vs-phone comparison (reader from DM guid), so judged not a real gap, with reasoning citing stream.ts:61-63 and read-receipts.ts.
Finding judged not real for replay's code (DM reader comes from guid independent of phone); additionally a SHARED_PHONE group-chat test was added in turn 12 and passes.

Replay reports "tsc clean, 289 core tests + 157 imessage tests passing, lint clean" and final "159 tests pass, typecheck and lint clean"; ultracite check shown clean; full `bun run build` not explicitly evidenced in shown output.

judge.reason: The replay answered the support question, drafted the Linear issue when Linear was unreachable, produced a plan with consumer shapes and no direction checks, and implemented inbound read receipts via a toReadMessages mapper wired into the message stream with the actor-equals-own-line bug fixed and DM reader derived from the chat guid, with logging kept via the SDK logger and the shared-mode review finding assessed against the code. Doubt remains because the core wrapNestedContent/webhook pieces were not added (target is a raw record), the stream-level arrival log was removed, and a full `bun run build` was not clearly evidenced.
